title: The Theatre Channel Episodes 1-5 reviewed
transcript: hello i'm paul seven lewis and welcome to one minute theater reviews in a moment i'll be reviewing five films from the theater cafe which feature west end artists singing songs from the musicals but first i'd just like to remind you that i present a weekly radio show about musicals it's on box office radio and you can listen to all the shows as podcasts on mixcloud.com okay if you recently watched musicals the greatest show on bbc and if you didn't you still can on iplayer it probably wetted your appetite for watching more performances of songs from the musicals and if it did i have just the thing for you if anything it's better because it doesn't have that inane chat between elaine page and idina menzel i'm talking about theater cafes five films on their theater channel each is less than half an hour and comprises about half a dozen songs with a different fairly loose theme the performers are bona fide west end stars the filming is beautiful and the direction and choreography are by the brilliant bill beamer who choreographed top hat and the national theatre's follies well that's the one minute review keep watching for more about the less familiar and the better known songs that are featured and who's singing them and more details about the fifth and final film which has just been released it's not all the same old same old in these films there are some less familiar songs the series starts with coffee in a cardboard cup which is a 20s style song by kandra and ebb from and the world goes round well i have to admit i didn't know this musical let alone this song but i want to know more after this brilliant fast-moving coffee cup tossing dance which takes place in the theater cafe another musical i didn't know is star mania but again i feel i'm missing something after an emotion laden song from it called le monde a stone which is sung by alex gomore among better known songs carrie hope fletcher and oliver ormsson sing a lovely version of suddenly seymour from the little shop of horus john owen jones plucks at the heartstrings with pity the child from chess and jenna russell gives an appropriately poignant but bitter rendition of ladies who lunch from sondheim's company oh and there's some joyful dancing to a brand new day from the wiz led by rachel john in episode 5 just released uh called the classics of broadway freddy fox sings a lascivious leather-coated ville common and money uh i can't wait for bill dema's production of cabaret and then there's coffee break from frank lesser's how to succeed in business without really trying in which the cafe iv chorus uh cavort around the theater cafe then gary wilmot gives us a strong rendition of lesser's luck be a lady from guys and dolls in a backstage setting i've always thought gary should be given the opportunity to do uh more weighty roles in musicals and this shows why then alan hawke and emily langham put on a happy face from bye bye birdie and put on a lovely soft shoe shuffle after that mishobis herself bonnie langford in a glittering burgundy catsuit sings i get a kick out of you from cole porter's anything goes and treats us to some extraordinarily high kicking masmery shows she can belt it out with the best of them when she sings everything's coming up roses from gypsy and finally marisha wallace gets up on the outside balcony of the national theater to sing a powerful version of somewhere from west side story as the camera moves around her and shows his views of the thames and london in the background michael england's lush orchestral arrangements on this and all the numbers are superb so another great film and if this sounds like an advertisement well it's just that i can't fault them the only question i have is whether you will think that between 12 and 15 pounds each or 50 pounds for all five is worth it i mean i had the privilege of seeing them for free so it's hard for me to make that judgment i can only say they are top quality i'm sure you'll want to play them again and again and a portion of the proceeds are going to the theater artists fund anyway i give these five theater channel films five stars and they stream on vimeo and you can get your pass from the theater cafe dot co dot uk i hope you found this review helpful please subscribe below if you'd like to be the first to know about my future reviews and features and you can read my reviews at one minute theater reviews dot co dot uk you can also follow me on twitter instagram and facebook thank you for watching you
